title: What is Your Favorite Gender, MLM? Gender Bias Evaluation in Multilingual Masked Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating sentence pairs that differ only by gendered words using lexicon-based and model-based methods, and comparing the masked language models' log-likelihoods and prediction confidence scores for male versus female words using three metrics: Multilingual Bias Evaluation (MBE), Strict Bias Metric (SBM), and Direct Comparison Bias Metric (DBM).
